units.source_text: 源氏大将连二条院也全然不去，只管真心地悲伤叹气，

en.t: General Genji did not even go to the Nijo residence at all, but only grieved and sighed with all his heart,

units.source_text: 朝朝暮暮为亡妻诵经念佛。

en.t: morning and evening he recited sutras and chanted prayers for his dead wife.

units.source_text: 诸情人处，只写了几封信去。

en.t: To his various lovers, he merely sent a few letters.

units.source_text: 六条妃子跟随女儿斋宫赴禁中左卫门府斋戒，

en.t: Lady Rokujo accompanied her daughter, the Ise priestess, to the Left Gate Guards office within the palace to observe purification rites,

units.source_text: 便以清心洁身为理由，不写信给源氏公子。

en.t: and on the grounds that she was purifying her mind and body, she did not write to Prince Genji.

units.source_text: 源氏公子早已痛感人世之苦厄，

en.t: Prince Genji had already felt keenly the sufferings and hardships of human life,

units.source_text: 如今又赋悼亡，更觉得一切都可厌弃。

en.t: and now, composing laments for the dead, he felt still more that everything was hateful and worth abandoning.

units.source_text: 若无新生婴儿之羁绊，颇思削发为僧，遁入空门。

en.t: Were it not for the bond of the newborn child, he would have very much wished to shave his head, become a monk, and enter the Buddhist path.

units.source_text: 然而想起了西殿里那个人，没有了他一定孤苦伶仃，心中不免怀念。

en.t: Yet when he thought of the person in the western wing, he could not help longing for her, thinking she would surely be lonely and forlorn without him.

units.source_text: 他夜夜独宿帐中，虽有众宫女在旁侍候，总是寂寞无聊，

en.t: Night after night he slept alone within the curtains, and although many court ladies attended nearby, he was always lonely and listless,

units.source_text: 常常想起古歌“秋日生离犹恋恋，何况死别两茫茫”之句。

en.t: often recalling the old poem: Even parting in life on an autumn day leaves such longing; how much more so when death parts two souls into vast uncertainty.

units.source_text: 他就寝后往往半睡半醒。

en.t: After going to bed, he was often half asleep and half awake.

units.source_text: 选用几个嗓音优美的僧人，叫他们晚间在旁诵经念佛。

en.t: He selected several monks with beautiful voices and had them recite sutras and chant prayers beside him at night.

units.source_text: 破晓时闻此声音，不胜凄凉寂寞之感。

en.t: Hearing those voices at daybreak, he could not bear the feeling of desolation and loneliness.

units.source_text: 深秋之夜，风声越来越觉凄凉，沁入肺腑。

en.t: On late autumn nights, the sound of the wind felt ever more bleak, sinking deep into his heart.

units.source_text: 不惯独眠的人，但觉长夜漫漫，不能安枕。

en.t: For one unused to sleeping alone, the long night seemed endless, and he could not rest peacefully.

units.source_text: 有一天清晨，朝雾弥漫之时，有一个人送一封深蓝色的信来，系在一枝初绽的菊花上。

en.t: One morning, when the dawn mist spread thickly, someone brought a deep blue letter tied to a branch of newly opening chrysanthemums.

units.source_text: 其人交了信即便回去。

en.t: After handing over the letter, the messenger immediately went back.

units.source_text: 源氏公子觉得此物甚是风流潇洒，一看，是六条妃子的笔迹。

en.t: Prince Genji found the presentation remarkably elegant and tasteful; when he looked, it was in Lady Rokujo's hand.

units.source_text: 信上写道：“久未问候，此心想蒙谅鉴。

en.t: The letter said: I have not written for a long time, but I trust you will understand and forgive what is in my heart.
